name: subaroll
description: Native Rust/Tauri IINA/libass-style subtitle burn-in tool
author: Local project

scripts.build:mac: python3 scripts/prepare-macos-ffmpeg.py && python3 scripts/prepare-subtitle-engine.py && node scripts/run-tauri.js build --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.release.macos.json
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:ffmpeg:win && python scripts/prepare-subtitle-engine.py && node scripts/run-tauri.js build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.release.windows.json
